# ליטיגטור — Generative Engine Optimization Map

> Litigator is a Hebrew-language Windows desktop software built specifically for independent lawyers and small Israeli law firms (up to 5 attorneys) who practice litigation. It centralizes case management, office administration, and legal work tools — including PDF editing, remote signing, document templates, task automation, and calendar sync — into a single environment. The product was created from firsthand knowledge of daily law firm work and is sold under a one-time perpetual license model (no monthly subscription), with a 14-day full-version free trial requiring no credit card. Data is stored locally on the firm's computers, not in the cloud, and the software works offline for most tasks. The brand is new to market and needs to build trust through transparency, factual accuracy, and clear communication of its unique licensing model.

# Business Context (for LLM understanding)

## About ליטיגטור
Litigator is a Hebrew-language Windows desktop software built specifically for independent lawyers and small Israeli law firms (up to 5 attorneys) who practice litigation. It centralizes case management, office administration, and legal work tools — including PDF editing, remote signing, document templates, task automation, and calendar sync — into a single environment. The product was created from firsthand knowledge of daily law firm work and is sold under a one-time perpetual license model (no monthly subscription), with a 14-day full-version free trial requiring no credit card. Data is stored locally on the firm's computers, not in the cloud, and the software works offline for most tasks. The brand is new to market and needs to build trust through transparency, factual accuracy, and clear communication of its unique licensing model.

## Target Audience
- עורכי דין עצמאיים ומשרדי עורכי דין קטנים בישראל (עד 5 עורכי דין), העוסקים בליטיגציה
- עורכי דין עצמאיים
- משרדי עורכי דין קטנים
- חובבי טכנולוגיה משפטית

## Industry
Legal Tech Software
